Potential Conflicts of Interest

  1. As a Governance Lead at the Cardano Foundation, my professional role aligns closely with my activities as a DRep. This could create perceived overlaps in responsibilities and interests.
  2. Participation in committees such as the Civics Committee and Parameter Committee could lead to potential biases when evaluating governance proposals.
  3. My involvement in drafting the Cardano Constitution and conducting workshops positions me as both a practitioner and advocate, which may influence my decisions.

Interests and Alliances

  1. I disclose any financial or professional relationships with entities within the Cardano ecosystem, including organizations influencing my voting behavior.
  2. My voting policies for governance actions involving such entities will be publicly shared to ensure transparency and avoid potential conflicts of interest.

Voting Process

  1. Policy on Abstaining: I will abstain only if insufficient information is available to make an informed decision.
  2. Policy on Disclosures: All voting decisions will include rationale, referencing applicable constitutional principles, expert opinions, and relevant governance policies.

Disclosure Updates

  1. Frequency: Updates will be provided at least every three months.
  2. Pre-Voting Updates: Information will be refreshed and shared two weeks before significant governance actions.
  3. Notification: Updates will be communicated via my social channels, including my X profile and DRep Telegram channel.

Feedback Mechanism

  1. Delegators are encouraged to join my DRep Telegram channel to share their insights and concerns.
  2. A process will be established to evaluate feedback and implement improvements or provide rationale for rejection.

Adherence to Code of Conduct

I commit to adhering to the DRep Code of Conduct, focusing on values of immutability, resilience, transparency, security, and accountability. Additionally, I will abide by the Community Code of Conduct as defined by the Cardano Foundation, ensuring respectful and harassment-free interactions.

Acknowledgment

I, Nicolas Cerny, affirm that the information provided in this disclosure form is accurate to the best of my knowledge and commit to maintaining transparency and accountability in my role as a DRep.
